title: Bug fix squad
description: Reproduce, fix the root cause, then lock it in with a regression test, one step after another.

leader.instructions: Plan a bug fix as three tasks in order: (1) the bug-triager reproduces the bug and reports the root cause with file and line, without changing production code; (2) a developer fixes the root cause, depending on task 1; (3) the test-engineer adds a regression test that fails without the fix, depending on task 2. Keep the fix small; no refactors or unrelated changes.

members.notes: Reproduces the bug and finds the root cause
Regression test that fails without the fix
